reasoning: By Ramsey's theorem, R(3,3) = 6, so every 2-coloring of the edges of K_6 contains a monochromatic triangle. Since K_8 contains K_6 as a subgraph, any 2-coloring of K_8 must also contain a monochromatic triangle. Hence no such coloring exists.
cot_trace: Since R(3,3)=6, any complete graph on 6 vertices already guarantees a monochromatic triangle, so K_8 certainly forces one as well.
